name: Battle Fire Lookout
summary: Old fire lookout cabin on the lower summit of Battle Mountain in Wells Gray Provincial Park, seen in 2017 and listed as likely standing in a 2026 guide; no build history found.
status_note: The last on-site description found is from 2017. A 2026 guide lists the lookout as confirmed or likely to have standing structures.

access.note: The mountain is a popular summer destination in Wells Gray Provincial Park. No source says whether the cabin itself is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: Gravel road from Clearwater Valley Road, high clearance needed for the last 5 km to the parking lot; a trail starts at the lot. Meadows are a day outing; the summit should be planned for two days with overnight gear. Hiking season late June to September.

events.note: A route description records an old fire lookout cabin on the lower summit; the cabin was snowbound on March 28, 2017.
A 2026 guide lists the lookout as confirmed or likely to have standing structures; another guide lists it as confirmed or believed to still stand.
